name: Winnowing
clause: For each player, you choose a creature that player controls. Then each player sacrifices all other creatures they control that don't share a creature type with the chosen creature they control.

needs.proposedSignature: Filter.sharesCreatureTypeWith?: Ref | 'chosen'  plus TargetSpec.sharedTypeGroup?: true (several picks of one requirement must agree)
needs.semantics: Target legality and mass-sacrifice filters that compare creature types between two objects — 'two target creatures you control that share a creature type', 'creatures that don't share a creature type with the chosen creature'. Checked both when targets are offered (legal.ts) and when they are re-checked on resolution.
needs.clause: Two target creatures you control that share a creature type can't be blocked this turn.

needs.proposedSignature: { op: 'choose-for-each-player'; chooser: ScopeWho; from: ObjectSet; picks: Filter[]; bind: 'chosen' }  followed by { op: 'sacrifice'; who: 'each-player'; what: { unchosen: true, ... } }
needs.semantics: One player picks, out of every player's board, one permanent per listed filter; everything not picked is then sacrificed by its own controller. Needs a Decision the CONTROLLER answers on behalf of each player, a named binding for the picks and an `unchosen` filter flag.
needs.clause: For each player, you choose from among the permanents that player controls an artifact, a creature, an enchantment, and a planeswalker. Then each player sacrifices all other nonland permanents they control.
